task.title: Thread-Safe In-Memory Order Management System
task.description: Design and implement an in-memory order processing engine for a high-frequency trading simulation. The engine must process incoming orders based on priority, provide fast ID-based lookups, track historical operations, and maintain top high-value orders dynamically using Java Collections Framework.
requirements: Implement an OrderService class that uses ConcurrentHashMap to store and retrieve orders by unique String orderID in O(1) time complexity.
Maintain a PriorityQueue for active pending orders, prioritized by an OrderPriority enum (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) and secondary tie-breaker by insertion timestamp.
Implement a least-recently-used (LRU) order history log using LinkedHashMap with access-order enabled and a maximum capacity of 100 entries.
Provide a method getTopNOrdersByValue(int n) that returns the top N highest-value orders without sorting the entire collection on every invocation.
Ensure all operations mutating the collection state are thread-safe and verified using multi-threaded JUnit tests.
deliverables: Java source code containing models, custom comparators, and the core OrderService implementation.
JUnit 5 unit test suite covering priority ordering, LRU eviction behavior, edge cases, and thread safety.
README document explaining collection choices and big-O time/space complexities for each method.
